# US-204: abuse risk per customer and per return request

<!-- Generated by `python -m ml.risk --data data --out artifacts --scores data` from the data (no wall-clock value). Do not edit by hand: rerun the command. -->

Story US-204 (spec 8.4 and 8.6; tests MOD-04 to MOD-08, MOD-12, FAIR-01 to FAIR-03). Method and limits: [docs/risk-model.md](../risk-model.md).

**Every number below is synthetic**: measured on the generated Navigli Fashion store, whose behaviours are design hypotheses planted by the generator and calibrated on real ASOS aggregates. None is a measure on real customers or a promise for a real shop. The labels come from the generator's ground truth (truth/labels, read by this offline job only, rule 12).

- Main store, features: ReturnRing features-v1 (pipeline.features; reference model v1; value value-v1-2026-10-13; evidence evidence-v1-2026-10-13), computed from: Navigli Fashion generator, calibrated on ASOS GraphReturns aggregates (calibration: ASOS GraphReturns, McGowan et al. 2023, arXiv:2302.14096, OSF c793h, CC BY 4.0; split periods per the paper: train 2021-09-01..2021-10-31, test 2021-10-01..2021-11-30; calibration: aggregates of the train split by pipeline/ingest/asos_profile.py. Rates, counts and purchases per customer come from the train events (2021-09-01..2021-10-31); product types, prices, return rates and reason shares come from the train product table, whose aggregates equal the test table's for every shared variant, so their window is the test window too (ADR-10); hence the period 2021-09-01..2021-11-30; calibration nature real; sha256 f49ce3711edd; seed 42, scale 1, scenario main; store period 2025-10-01..2026-09-30); period 2025-10-01..2026-09-30; nature synthetic.
- Out-of-distribution store, features: ReturnRing features-v1 (pipeline.features; reference model v1; value value-v1-2026-10-13; evidence evidence-v1-2026-10-13; reference trained on Navigli Fashion generator, calibrated on ASOS GraphReturns aggregates (calibration: ASOS GraphReturns, McGowan et al. 2023, arXiv:2302.14096, OSF c793h, CC BY 4.0; split periods per the paper: train 2021-09-01..2021-10-31, test 2021-10-01..2021-11-30; calibration: aggregates of the train split by pipeline/ingest/asos_profile.py. ## Ablation A0 to A4, customer unit (MOD-04)

Origin: main store (see the header). Period: features at 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 (the store up to 2026-10-01), labels static. Population: held-out test groups, every customer known at the evaluation time (6,009 customers, 271 abusive). Nature: synthetic.

Same split and same rows for every model. AUPRC and precision at k rank the score before calibration (isotonic calibration is monotone but merges scores into ties); the risk threshold, precision, recall, false-positive rates and ECE use the calibrated risk. The threshold is the lowest calibrated risk with precision >= 0.8 on the validation groups (spec 8.6). FPR: non-abusive customers flagged, over non-abusive customers. FPR high-value: the same among the non-abusive customers in the top 30% by customer value (value >= 125.61 EUR at the evaluation time); value only chooses who is counted, it is never a feature (rule 6).

### Feature sets and largest contributions

- **A0** (rules, 3 features): `return_rate_to_date`, `median_days_to_return`, `mean_line_price_eur`.
  Rules fitted on the training rows (quantile with the best single-rule F1): `return_rate_to_date >= 0.75`; `median_days_to_return <= 6`; `mean_line_price_eur >= 52.18`.
- **A1** (xgboost, 18 features): `return_rate_to_date`, `median_days_to_return`, `mean_line_price_eur`, `n_orders`, `n_lines`, `n_delivered_lines`, `n_observations`, `n_returns`, `return_rate`, `size_share`, `changed_mind_share`, `not_as_expected_share`, `other_reason_share`, `tenure_days`, `n_welcome_coupons_used`, `n_promo_coupons_used`, `coupon_order_share`, `weekend_order_share`.
  Rounds kept 70. Largest shares of total gain (contribution to the score, not a cause): `return_rate_to_date` 0.59, `mean_line_price_eur` 0.10, `changed_mind_share` 0.10, `size_share` 0.04, `median_days_to_return` 0.04.
- **A2** (xgboost, 26 features): `return_rate_to_date`, `median_days_to_return`, `mean_line_price_eur`, `n_orders`, `n_lines`, `n_delivered_lines`, `n_observations`, `n_returns`, `return_rate`, `size_share`, `changed_mind_share`, `not_as_expected_share`, `other_reason_share`, `tenure_days`, `n_welcome_coupons_used`, `n_promo_coupons_used`, `coupon_order_share`, `weekend_order_share`, `cluster_size`, `shared_strong_ids`, `welcome_coupons`, `n_distinct_cards`, `creation_spread_days`, `welcome_coupons_per_account`, `cluster_return_rate`, `strong_id_share`.
  Rounds kept 77. Largest shares of total gain (contribution to the score, not a cause): `cluster_return_rate` 0.60, `mean_line_price_eur` 0.12, `changed_mind_share` 0.09, `cluster_size` 0.07, `median_days_to_return` 0.04.
- **A3** (xgboost, 29 features): `return_rate_to_date`, `median_days_to_return`, `mean_line_price_eur`, `n_orders`, `n_lines`, `n_delivered_lines`, `n_observations`, `n_returns`, `return_rate`, `size_share`, `changed_mind_share`, `not_as_expected_share`, `other_reason_share`, `tenure_days`, `n_welcome_coupons_used`, `n_promo_coupons_used`, `coupon_order_share`, `weekend_order_share`, `cluster_size`, `shared_strong_ids`, `welcome_coupons`, `n_distinct_cards`, `creation_spread_days`, `welcome_coupons_per_account`, `cluster_return_rate`, `strong_id_share`, `expected_returns`, `residual`, `residual_z`.
  Rounds kept 76. Largest shares of total gain (contribution to the score, not a cause): `cluster_return_rate` 0.59, `mean_line_price_eur` 0.12, `changed_mind_share` 0.09, `cluster_size` 0.07, `median_days_to_return` 0.04.
- **A4**: the 29 features of A3 plus GraphSAGE embedding columns; not run: phase 6 (GPU), EmbeddingSource hook in ml/risk/features.py.
- An account with no linked account has its cluster features computed on itself (pipeline.graph), so for most customers `cluster_return_rate` is close to `return_rate_to_date`: gain moves between correlated features, and the gain shares do not measure what the graph adds. The ablation rows do.
- No feature set holds a forbidden feature (gender, country, age, names, hashes, raw identifiers: `contracts.parquet.forbidden_features`, FAIR-01) or a customer value column (rule 6); both are checked when the module loads and before every training.

## Request unit (spec 8.4: the score at the moment of the request)

Origin: main store (see the header). Period: withdrawal-path requests that arrived from 2026-07-01 to the evaluation time; features at 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 (the store up to 2026-10-01), labels static. Population: requests of the held-out test groups (4,218 requests, 317 from abusive customers). Nature: synthetic.

Each request is scored as known when it arrived: days since delivery, reason, price and the item's return rate among other customers at that instant, plus the customer's row from the last nightly snapshot computed strictly before the request (here the monthly snapshots of features/customer_features and the clusters built at the same instants). 6,111 of 50,943 requests of the main store came before any snapshot of their account and have no customer features. Defect and non-conformity requests follow the guarantee path and are never scored (rule 4). A request inherits its customer's label.

## Thresholds and quadrants at the evaluation time (spec 8.6)

Origin: batch scoring (`python -m ml.scoring`) of every customer of the main store at 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00. Period: 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30. Nature: synthetic.

- Customer risk threshold: 0.2143; request risk threshold: 0.4340 (lowest calibrated risk with precision >= 0.8 on the validation groups).
- Value threshold: 120.05 EUR, the 70th percentile of the customer value at the evaluation time. Value orients the quadrant, never the risk (rule 6).
- Customers with insufficient evidence get no quadrant (standard terms, US-307): 3,349 of 20,000.
- Open returns at the evaluation time: 623, of which 481 scored and 142 on the guarantee path (not scored); 3 scored without an earlier snapshot of the account.

| Quadrant | Customers |
| --- | --- |
| Q1 | 5,891 |
| Q2 | 9,991 |
| Q3 | 22 |
| Q4 | 747 |
| none | 3,349 |

Q3 and Q4 are proposals: a human approves every restrictive action (rule 5).

## FAIR-02: false positives by segment

Origin: batch scores at 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 of the held-out test customers (main store). Period: the store up to the evaluation time. Nature: synthetic.

A false positive is a non-abusive customer flagged by the model (risk >= threshold) or placed in Q3/Q4 (high risk with sufficient evidence: what a customer would see after approval). Gap: the segment's rate minus the rate of all 5,738 non-abusive customers (0.52% flagged, 0.38% in Q3/Q4), in percentage points; a warning above 5 points either way. Segments with few customers are noisy: read the counts. Price bands are the thirds of the mean line price (cuts 26.85 and 33.08 EUR).

## Data, split and method

Origin: main store. Nature: synthetic.

Split (MOD-07): groups of customers joined by a graph cluster at the evaluation time, a ground-truth ring or a ground-truth family; groups stratified by their most specific behaviour (ring, wardrober, family, other), shuffled with seed 42; 30% of each stratum to test, 20% of the rest to validation. Customers known at the evaluation time, by side and group stratum:

| Side | ring | wardrober | family | other |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| train | 166 | 336 | 389 | 10,304 |
| validation | 43 | 84 | 93 | 2,576 |
| test | 91 | 180 | 218 | 5,520 |

Clusters per decision time: 2025-11-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2025-12-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-02-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-03-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-04-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-05-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-06-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-07-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-08-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-09-01T00:00:00+00:00: built by pipeline.graph at this instant; 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00: features/clusters file.

- XGBoost on CPU (xgboost-cpu 3.2.0, hist, one thread), depth 4, learning rate 0.1, gamma 1, lambda 2, early stopping after 5 rounds on the validation log loss, seed 42; isotonic calibration on validation. The same code runs on the MI300X with device=cuda in phase 6.
- Contributions: XGBoost's native TreeSHAP (pred_contribs), top 3 by absolute value among the features with a known value, shown as fixed phrases (Italian and English) that say they are contributions to the score, not causes.
- Circularity: the generator plants the behaviours the features look for, so the main store measures consistency with the generator. The OOD store changes the rules and is the honest stress test.
